bouquet.summary: Asian Paints combines industry‑leading quality metrics—high ROE/ROCE, low leverage and strong margins—with a valuation that remains attractive relative to peers, making it the best blend of quality and value today.
bouquet.whyToday: The earnings beat and overseas expansion announcement created a fresh catalyst, pushing the stock higher and highlighting its strong fundamentals, which makes it the standout pick for today.

positives: ROCE above 25%, indicating efficient capital use
Strong EBITDA margin (~25%) and stable cash flows
Robust brand franchise and pricing power
PE ~28x, below the sector average of ~35x
PB ~8x, reasonable for a high‑margin business
PEG close to 1.2, indicating modest growth pricing
Dividend yield ~0.6% with a history of steady payouts
negatives: Higher PE relative to pure consumer staples
